Salvage & Underwater Works.

Discuss marine salvage, underwater recovery and specialist underwater works with Cyclonite Tech in Seri Manjung. Planning begins with the object, location and site conditions.

Service scope

How we can help.

  • Underwater salvage and recovery
  • Underwater salvage consultancy
  • Underwater structure demolition and removal
  • Controlled scuttling, including artificial reef placement

Useful answers

Your questions, answered.

What salvage services does Cyclonite Tech offer?+

Our services include underwater salvage and recovery, salvage consultancy, underwater structure removal, controlled scuttling and artificial reef placement.

Can I enquire about a recovery project in Lumut or Perak?+

Yes. Contact the team with the location, depth and object details. Site conditions, resources and availability need to be assessed for each project.

Based in Seri Manjung, Perak. For project enquiries around Manjung, Lumut, Sitiawan or another location, see our local enquiry information and tell us where the work is needed.
